signals.text: Barcelona monitor Kane & Haaland - Wednesday's gossip. Barcelona are monitoring Harry Kane and Erling Haaland, Nick Woltemade could be a replacement for Kane at Bayern Munich, and Manchester United are interested in Jarrad Branthwaite, plus more.
Youth star JJ Gabriel, 15, on brink of leaving Man Utd. Manchester United's highly-rated 15-year-old forward JJ Gabriel is on the verge of leaving the club.
